function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world (as of 2026).  The list includes companies that produce licensed vaccines for routine immunization, pandemic response, and specialty indications.

| # | Company | Headquarters | Key Vaccine Platforms | Notable Products |
|---|---------|--------------|-----------------------|------------------|
| 1 | **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | mRNA, protein subunit | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – COVID‑19; Prevnar 23 (pneumococcal conjugate) |
| 2 | **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | mRNA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax) – COVID‑19; mRNA‑1647 (influenza) |
| 3 | **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Brunswick, USA | Viral vector (Ad26) | Ad26.COV2.S (Johnson & Johnson COVID‑19) |
| 4 | **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | Protein subunit | NVX-CoV2373 (COVID‑19) |
| 5 | **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | Viral vector (ChAdOx1) | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (AZD1222) – COVID‑19; HPV vaccines |
| 6 | **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | Brentford, UK | Protein subunit, conjugate, inactivated | Shingrix (herpes zoster), Menveo (meningococcal), Fluzone (influenza) |
| 7 | **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | Inactivated, subunit, conjugate | Fluzone, Menactra, Vaxzevria (COVID‑19) |
| 8 | **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | Inactivated, subunit, conjugate | MMR, Varicella, HPV (Gardasil), COVID‑19 (mRNA‑1273/Moderna partnership) |
| 9 | **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | Inactivated, subunit | Covaxin (COVID‑19) |
|10 | **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | Inactivated | CoronaVac (COVID‑19) |
|11 | **Sinopharm** | Beijing, China | Inactivated | BBIBP‑CorV (COVID‑19) |
|12 | **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | mRNA | CVnCoV (COVID‑19) |
|13 | **Biontech (formerly BioNTech)** | Mainz, Germany | mRNA | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – COVID‑19 |
|14 | **Takeda** | Tokyo, Japan | Inactivated, subunit | Takeda’s influenza, rabies, and COVID‑19 candidates |
|15 | **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Inactivated, subunit | Covishield (AstraZeneca‑Covishield) – COVID‑19; various routine vaccines |

### How to Use This List
- **Research**: If you’re looking into vaccine development pipelines, focus on the companies with active mRNA or viral‑vector programs.
- **Supply Chain**: For procurement, note that many of these firms have global manufacturing hubs (e.g., Pfizer in the U.S., GSK in the U.K., Sanofi in France).
- **Regulatory**: Each company’s products are licensed by national authorities (FDA, EMA, WHO, etc.). Check the latest approvals for your region.

Let me know if you’d like deeper details on any specific manufacturer, their clinical trial status, or their manufacturing capacities!
